title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Consumer Decision Making Behaviour
description: Unlock the art of predicting and influencing consumer choices with our Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Consumer Decision Making Behaviour.
longDescription: The concept of consumer buying behaviour. Consumer buying decision making process. Stages of consumer decision making. Factors influencing decision making. The influence of heuristics on consumer decision making. This course aims to equip learners with a deep understanding of the theoretical and practical aspects of consumer buying behaviour, including the decision-making process, stages involved, factors that influence decision making, and the impact of heuristics, enabling them to develop effective marketing strategies and make informed business decisions. Through a combination of theoretical concepts, case studies, and interactive exercises, learners will gain the skills and knowledge necessary to succeed in a constantly evolving marketplace.
